tools.name: senta_search_clients
tools.description: Find the practice's clients by keywords. Returns matching clients with their id (`_id`) and name (`title`). Use the id with senta_get_client, senta_list_jobs or senta_add_note. GET /api/clients/search.

tools.name: senta_get_client
tools.description: Read one client: name, state, type, business area, contacts (name, email, mobile, shareholding), address and the other fields the practice configured. GET /api/clients/{id}.

tools.name: senta_list_client_view
tools.description: Read a saved client list of the practice (the same filter and columns as in the Senta app). The view id is the last part of the list's address: https://<practice>.senta.co/c/l/v08a361263f4a has the view id v08a361263f4a. Column names are the list's column titles (for example "Client name", "State").

tools.name: senta_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (id, client id `cid`, job template id `wid`, title and main date). Filter by client, job template or status (pending, ready, overdue, completed, cancelled). With no filter this is every job of the practice, so filter when you can. GET /api/jobs.

tools.name: senta_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: create a new client (company) in the practice. A name (title) is required; the other fields depend on the practice's own client form. Returns the new client with its id. Check senta_search_clients first so you do not create a duplicate. POST /api/clients.

tools.name: senta_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: partially update an existing client; only submitted properties are changed, per Senta's Client API. tools.name: senta_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a client, optionally attached to one of its jobs. The text may contain simple HTML. Returns the note. POST /api/notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: senta_get_client, senta_create_client · Private data: senta_get_client, senta_update_client · Public sink: senta_get_client, senta_create_client, senta_add_note · Destructive: senta_update_client.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: senta_get_client, senta_create_client · Private data: senta_get_client, senta_update_client · Public sink: senta_get_client, senta_create_client, senta_add_note · Destructive: senta_update_client

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
